content_zh: 第1章 混乱KTV唐青青白天说的倒是咬牙切齿，但到了晚上的时候，还真的就犯了嘀咕。说到底也是个女孩子，而且和一个陌生男人同处一个屋檐下。要说没有一丝一毫的顾忌，那是不符合情理的。事实上，假如不是易军在撞车后敢于仗义执言，敢于正面那些痞子，并且好心的主动帮她打出租车离开交警队，表现出了一股铮铮正气，唐青青甚至还不敢住在他家里。一个成熟男人的铮铮正气，对于女人总有一种摧枯拉朽的魔力。哪怕那些喜欢油头粉面小男生的女孩子，同样不会拒绝被这种成熟雄性气质所吸引。此外，易军本人也有一种常人所不具备的气质，那就是一种特有的安全感。比如在看待唐青青这个小美女的时候，寻常雄性牲口的眼中总会有种不自然的猥亵和不洁净，但易军的眼神之中没有。女人的第六感很强烈，这种第六感往往会让她们头脑一昏，做出一些莫名其妙的事情。如今，唐青青要为自己的头脑一昏付出一点小小的代价了。这个代价说大不大，无非就是睡不着觉而已。大夏天的，易军这该死的家里连个小风扇都没有，更不要提什么空调。这倒不是因为易军经济紧张的原因，毕竟风扇值不了几个钱。关键是易军的忍受力出奇的强悍，对于严寒酷暑之类的小问题几乎可以无视。甚至，连现在的生活对他而言，都显得有些过于优渥安适了。可是，他能够无视酷暑而酣然入睡，不代表娇滴滴的唐小美女同样可以。如今已经是凌晨一点，悲剧的唐青青依旧在那张小床上翻烧饼，辗转反侧睡不着。好热呀！更可气的是，她终究只是一个女孩子，一墙之隔就是个大男子席地而卧，她总不至于就敞开了门窗。所以，大夏天的把自己住的地方关得像是一个罐头盒子，于是更加难忍。浑身香汗淋漓。而时间长了，流汗多了，即便美女的汗液也同样不再有什么体香，这让小美女极度抓狂。再也无法忍受了！唐青青蹑手蹑脚下了床，悄悄打开了卧室和客厅的门。露出个缝隙一瞧，顿时来了气——易军这家伙倒是睡得甜蜜蜜！这货本来就不怕热，现在还打开了房门吹着那穿堂小风，当然自在多了！唐青青有点牙痒痒，恨恨然的踮起脚尖儿走了出去，直奔院子里那诱惑力十足的水龙头！脚下的凉拖鞋、身上的睡衣、手中的毛巾，都是下午在门口儿小便利店里采购来的。唐青青只恨买了沐浴露也没法用，总不能真的来一个酣畅淋漓的淋浴。此时的唐青青，只穿着一袭宽松的睡衣。她倒是发了狠，里面什么都没穿——不然没法洗痛快了。细细的拧开了水龙头，清冽的自来水汩汩流出，柔软的毛巾赶紧把凉水接住。动静很小，小美女非常得意。半蹲下身子，拿起了凉丝丝的毛巾，轻轻从睡衣的裙摆下伸了进去。乍一接触到皮肤，那个爽呀！以至于小美女几乎要痛快得哼哼出声音来。月光下，这个美妙的身影偷偷摸摸，却自得其乐。她甚至都不想回那小小的卧室了，恨不能就这么一直洗下去。而在客厅里，躺在地上的易军眼皮动了动。虽然院子里的声音微乎其微，但没有躲过他变态的听力。甚至于，唐青青刚才悄悄下床的时候，他就已经听到了那常人难以察觉的小动静。这是一种很强大的感知能力，必须有足够的天分外加千锤百炼的努力。此时的易军微微笑了笑，不动声色的继续睡下。但是，仅仅过去了不到五分钟，院子里就传来了“啊”的一声尖叫！随即，又是“噗通”一声。易军猛然一个翻身，本能的一个鲤鱼打挺，动作干净利索。当他一个健步冲到门外的时候，顿时明白了一切——深更半夜的看不清，唐青青这是在水龙头旁的青石板上，一不小心踩滑了！“用帮忙吗？”倚着老式的门框，易军笑问。看到这没心没肺的笑，唐青青的气就不打一处来。而且，她怎能想到易军的反应和行动速度这么变态，本能的以为这家伙刚才一直在偷看了！要不然，怎么会这么迅速的冲出房门呢？“你这个大色狼，竟然偷看老子擦澡！”唐青青爆发了。“不识好人心。”易军撇了撇嘴，他才懒得跟这刁蛮小美女解释，还不如睡觉来得实在。不过，这货不是个积口德的，走就走吧，还偏偏笑着咕哝：“月下美人浴，本来是多好的意境。偏偏成了月下美人屁股蹲儿，顿时就大煞风景了，哈哈哈！”“混蛋易军！”小美女怒冲冲站了起来，顾不得娇嫩的屁股摔多疼，这就要去找易军麻烦。但忽然感觉到屁股上凉飕飕的，这才意识到自己睡衣的后面全都湿了，紧紧贴在了身上！都是水渍啊，而且还有些泥巴！下午刚刚买了这条睡衣，没有可换的了。更重要的是，现在要是冲到易军身边去找他麻烦，自己的体型可就真的要完美的暴露了。而这时候，易军躺在地板的凉席上，双臂抱着脑袋又笑道：“说你笨你还真笨！水龙头旁就有洗脸盆，你就不会接一盆水去卧室里擦啊！”唐青青欲哭无泪。当然，刚刚消停一点的火气，又上来了一些。而易军又笑道：“当然，除非你是在刻意追求月下美人浴的意境。”“你找死！”狂野小美女的狂野本性，终于酣畅淋漓的爆发了！此时的易军，听到了外头哗啦啦的水声，再也不是那细水长流的汩汩声。皱了皱眉头，想了想，当即察觉到了不妙。刚刚坐起来，就看到身穿滴水睡衣的小美女，怒冲冲的端着半盆凉水，冲到了门口儿！狂野小美女这回是真的飚了。本来摔倒了就一肚子气，如今更是被易军的嘲弄搞得怒火中烧。“该死的家伙，你再敢说一句，老子泼你一个落汤鸡！”别指望出现什么“水泼不入”的武功境界，那根本就是个笑话。要是地方大了，易军还能轻易躲闪，偏偏这房间就巴掌大的地方，躲都不好躲。但是易军不怕，反而勾起嘴角笑道：“你要是敢泼水，哥就把这条大裤衩脱了！瞧你里头啥都没穿吧？巧了，哥也是。”强盗遇到贼祖宗了，狂野小美女咬牙切齿也无可奈何。这场景孤男寡女、深更半夜的，要是眼前这家伙真的把大裤衩都脱了，鬼知道会出现啥妖蛾子？！更何况，自己身上也只有一层薄薄的睡衣……看到唐青青端着半盆凉水不知所措，易军知道自己的心理攻势发挥效用了，自感得意。优哉游哉的继续躺在了地面上，哈哈一乐：“我看你还是赶紧回卧室，换件衣服再说吧！瞧你腰以下的地方，全都紧紧贴在身上了……对了，下午你好像只买了这一件睡衣吧？要是没得换，只能光着身子睡凉席了，倒是更凉快。不过，小心那凉席把你的细皮嫩肉压出一道道的纹路，一觉醒来成了一头小斑马，哈哈！”易军得意的大放厥词，终于要睡了。但是，如今的狂野小美女已经再也无法制怒了。哗啦！！！唐青青两只玉臂一震，半盆凉水终于泼了出去，直奔地面上的易军！“老子让你得瑟，有种你就脱！”浑身一个激灵的易军再度蹦了起来，简直像是一个弹起的钢簧，速度极快。不过已经晚了，浑身被水浇透，连那大裤衩也紧紧贴在了身上。“你……开几句玩笑至于吗！”没来由的被人泼了一盆水，易军也不乐，“你当哥真不敢脱是不是！”“脱就脱！老子活了十九年，还没见过光屁股的大男人是啥样呢！”唐青青一如既往的彪悍。易军顿时一愣。
content_en: Chapter 1 Chaos KTV Tang Qingqing spoke with gritted teeth during the day, but at night, she really started mumbling. After all, she is a girl, and she lives under the same roof with a strange man. It is unreasonable to say that there is no scruple at all. In fact, if Yi Jun had not dared to speak up after the car crash, dared to confront the gangsters, and kindly took the initiative to help her take a taxi and leave the traffic police team, showing a sense of righteousness, Tang Qingqing would not even dare to live in his house. The righteousness of a mature man always has a devastating power over women. Even those girls who like boys with oily heads and pink faces will not refuse to be attracted by this mature masculine temperament. In addition, Yi Jun himself also has a temperament that ordinary people do not possess, that is, a unique sense of security. For example, when looking at the little beauty Tang Qingqing, there is always an unnatural obscenity and uncleanness in the eyes of ordinary male animals, but there is no such thing in Yi Jun's eyes. Women have a very strong sixth sense, which often makes them dizzy and do some inexplicable things. Now, Tang Qingqing has to pay a small price for her confusion. The price is not high, it is nothing more than not being able to sleep. It's such a hot summer, Yi Jun's damn house doesn't even have a small fan, let alone an air conditioner. This is not because of Yi Jun's financial constraints. After all, the fan is not worth much money. The key is that Yi Jun's endurance is surprisingly strong, and he can almost ignore minor problems such as severe cold and heat. In fact, even his current life seems a bit too comfortable and comfortable for him. However, just because he was able to ignore the scorching heat and fall asleep soundly did not mean that the delicate Tang Xiaomei could do the same. It was already one o'clock in the morning, and the tragic Tang Qingqing was still flipping biscuits on the small bed, tossing and turning, unable to sleep. It's so hot! What's even more irritating is that she is only a girl after all. There is a grown man lying on the floor across the wall, so she can't open the doors and windows. Therefore, it is even more unbearable to shut up the place where I live like a can in the middle of summer. Sweat dripping all over. As time went by and she sweated more, even the beauty's sweat no longer had any body fragrance, which made the little beauty extremely crazy. I can't stand it anymore! Tang Qingqing tiptoed out of bed and quietly opened the doors to the bedroom and living room. When he peeked out of the gap, he immediately became angry - Yi Jun was sleeping sweetly! This guy is not afraid of heat to begin with, but now he opens the door and lets in the breeze, which makes him feel much more at ease! Tang Qingqing felt a little itchy and walked out on tiptoes angrily, heading straight for the alluring faucet in the yard! The sandals under my feet, the pajamas on my body, and the towel in my hand were all purchased at the small convenience store at the door in the afternoon. Tang Qingqing only regretted that she couldn't use the shower gel even though she bought it, so she couldn't really have a hearty shower. At this time, Tang Qingqing was only wearing loose pajamas. She was so angry that she didn't wear anything underneath - otherwise she wouldn't be able to wash herself. He carefully turned on the faucet, and the clear tap water gurgled out. A soft towel quickly caught the cold water. There was very little movement, and the little beauty was very proud. He squatted down, picked up the cold towel, and gently stretched it under the skirt of his pajamas. As soon as it touches the skin, it feels so good! So much so that the little beauty almost hummed with joy. Under the moonlight, this wonderful figure is furtive but enjoying itself. She didn't even want to go back to the small bedroom, she wished she could just keep washing like this. In the living room, Yi Jun's eyelids moved as he was lying on the ground. Although the sound in the yard was very faint, it did not escape his perverted hearing. Even when Tang Qingqing quietly got out of bed, he had already heard the small movement that was difficult for ordinary people to detect. This is a very powerful perceptual ability that requires sufficient talent and hard work. At this time, Yi Jun smiled slightly and continued to sleep calmly. However, less than five minutes passed before a scream of "Ah" came from the yard! Immediately, there was another "pop" sound. Yi Jun suddenly turned over and instinctively jumped up like a carp, his movements were clean and agile. When he rushed out the door, he suddenly understood everything - he couldn't see clearly in the middle of the night. Tang Qingqing accidentally slipped on the bluestone next to the faucet! "Can I help?" Yi Jun asked with a smile, leaning on the old-fashioned door frame. Seeing this heartless smile, Tang Qingqing became angry. Moreover, how could she have imagined that Yi Jun's reaction and speed of action were so abnormal? She instinctively thought that this guy had been peeking just now! Otherwise, why would you have rushed out of the room so quickly? "You big pervert, you actually peeked at me taking a shower!" Tang Qingqing exploded. "I don't know the heart of a good person." Yi Jun curled his lips. He didn't bother to explain to this unruly little beauty. He might as well go to sleep. However, this guy is not a man of words, so he just left and muttered with a smile: "Beauty bathing under the moon, what a beautiful mood it was. But it turned out to be a beautiful woman squatting on her butt under the moon, which immediately ruined the scenery, hahaha!" "Bastard Yi Jun!" The little beauty stood up angrily, not caring about the pain in her delicate buttocks, and she was going to trouble Yi Jun. But suddenly I felt a chill on my butt, and then I realized that the back of my pajamas was all wet and clinging tightly to my body! It’s all water stained, and there’s also some mud! I just bought this pair of pajamas this afternoon and I have nothing to change into. What's more important is that if he rushes to Yi Jun to cause trouble for him now, his body shape will be perfectly exposed. At this time, Yi Jun was lying on the mat on the floor, holding his head with his arms and laughing again: "You are stupid, but you are really stupid! There is a washbasin next to the faucet, why don't you pick up one?"
